source_snapshot.items: Intel GNR Patrol Scrub CE injection
source_snapshot.procedure: Apply extensive BIOS/DFX/RAS matrix; enable Patrol Scrub interval1/ECS, disable PTRR; verify/clear named registers; halt and inject one CE at0x8000 with PatrolConsume=True; verify MSCOD/retry, go and serial.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores exact injector/register/extlog/restoration gates and retains critical approval.

old_problem: Approved Intel harness, exact GNR topology/address-to-DIMM mapping, project BIOS equivalents, safe volatile-register clear, expected MSCOD/retry/extlog fields, halt/go recovery and restoration are missing.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires an approved injection tool, isolated environment and Recovery. The literal PatrolConsume injection is detailed, but0x8000/mc2.ch0 and BIOS/DFX unlocks are platform-specific core safety semantics; generic corrected logs cannot prove patrol consumption or safely replace vendor approval.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row157, same-row AI fields and history2542; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved every BIOS category, Patrol Scrub/ECS/PTRR setup, exact single injection, register paths, go/serial and extlog criterion.
Distinguished PatrolConsume background handling from row158 Demand Scrub and required topology-bound evidence.
Preserved preexisting logs and required full security-setting restoration; no BIOS change, clear, halt, injection, go, reboot or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Intel GNR topology-bound Patrol Scrub CE injection
test_case.purpose: On the intended DIMM, prove one CE is consumed specifically by Patrol Scrub and produces the expected firmware-first MCA/retry/ELog path without unexpected escalation.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/injector version/hash/license and qualified FAE
GNR stepping/BIOS/BMC/OS plus socket/IMC/channel/DIMM and0x8000/mc2.ch0 mapping
Project equivalents and restoration baseline for every BIOS/GRUB/DFX knob
Expected scrubctl/en_patspr, correctable MSCOD, retry and extlog_mem_event fields/timing
Dedicated SUT, stable power, serial/OOB, halt/go/crash recovery and no-retry authorization
test_case.test_command: After critical authorization, qualified operator applies/verifies the exact mapped settings and preserved baselines, clears only approved volatile target registers, performs one vendor-harness `halt(); resetInjectorLockCheck(); injectMemError(0x8000, errType="ce", PatrolConsume=True)`, collects named scrub/MCA/retry evidence, executes `go()`, correlates serial/FTrace/ELog/OS/BMC evidence, then restores every temporary setting and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped DIMM patrol engine consumes exactly the injected CE; expected correctable MSCOD/retry and timestamped extlog_mem_event appear with firmware handling, no fatal/UE/crash or wrong-target evidence occurs, system resumes healthy and all security/RAS settings return to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact harness/target/settings identity, single successful patrol-consumed CE, all named register/extlog evidence, no unexpected severity and complete restoration. Wrong mapping, missing/incorrect evidence, hang/crash, UE/fatal escalation or restoration failure fails/blocks per engineer.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT with explicit FAE/injection authorization and proven recovery.
Never infer0x8000/DIMM or BIOS paths; verify immutable mapping first.
Preserve general logs; clear only approved volatile test registers after baseline.
One injection only; stop on anomaly without automatic reinjection/reboot.
expected_evidence: Platform/harness/target identity and mapped setting matrix
Complete BIOS/GRUB/DFX restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, hang or unexpected severity preserve evidence and use only the approved serial/OOB/BIOS recovery. Do not reinject or reboot automatically; restore settings under owner control and revalidate final security/RAS state.

source_conflict.reason: Setup, PatrolConsume injection and extlog criterion form one coherent path; platform mappings/decoders are missing OEM inputs.

blocked.reason: The operation/evidence chain is detailed; harness, mapping and approval are RPUC prerequisites.
